title: Refunds Credited against the Meals Carried to Pay
content:
A refund returned to stored value on an Employee Meal Account is credited against the meals carried to the employee's pay. A refund that restores employer allowance is never credited here, because it returns the employer's own funding rather than the employee's money. The stale refund share is 50 percent.

**Clause.** Where the plan returns refunds to stored value and a refund other than one restoring employer allowance has been returned on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the refund credited is the whole of those refunds. Where the plan returns refunds to stored value, no such refund has been returned in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked and one has been returned in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, the refund credited is those refunds taken at the stale refund share, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where none of that holds, no refund is credited.

## How each plan returns a refund

| Meal plan | Refund is returned |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | to the card originally used |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | to stored value |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | through payroll |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | to stored value |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | to stored value |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | through payroll |

## The bands

| The plan's refund method | Refunds other than allowance restorations | Credited |
|---|---|---|
| To stored value | Returned in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | The whole value of those refunds |
| To stored value | None in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, some in the three months running back from the day the account is worked | 50 percent of the value of those refunds |
| To stored value | None in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked | Nothing |
| Through payroll, or to the card originally used | Any | Nothing |

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan returning refunds to stored value, $18.00 of refunds returned in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked is credited in full. With nothing in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked but $18.00 over the three months running back from the day the account is worked, $9.00 is credited. On a plan returning refunds through payroll, nothing is credited whatever the ledger shows.
